extraction.Name: Elizabeth Prue Janis
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: I first mortgaged, then sold it.
extraction.Fee Patent Date: some nine or ten years ago
extraction.Occupation/Income: my husband and I support them
extraction.NOTES: Patent received at Farmer's office at Okreek; did not sign a receipt for the patent; did not make application for fee patent; received $2400 in cash for the land; does not remember amount of mortgage; dissatisfied because she wanted more money for her land but could not get it; has seven children; subscribed and sworn before Jas. W. Cross, Notary Public, March 20, 1929, commission expires 4/28/32
